answer.text: Direct = lower TER (no distributor commission); Regular = through distributor, higher TER

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Direct saves 50-100 bps/year on TER. Regular pays distributor trail. **The Trap:** Direct requires client self-service via AMC portal. **Cross-Exam Context:** V-A. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** High-AUM, direct-plan MFs have materially better returns than Regular over long periods.
